    If you are new

    Where to start

    The calendar is the exact schedule, but almost everything on it is one of these three. You do not need to sign up for anything — turn up to any of them.

    The weekly rhythm

    • Meetings Thursdays, 4:04 pm — M306
    • Workdays Wednesdays, 5:00 pm
    • Saturdays, 12:00 pm
    • Labs McLaury 101 & 107
    More about joining

    Where to find us

    Our main lab is McLaury 101, with a second lab in McLaury 107. On a workday there is almost always someone in there, whether or not anything is on the calendar.

    About the team

    Competition season

    Design work runs through the fall and competitions follow in the spring. Those dates land on the calendar as soon as they are confirmed, and the travel ones are worth planning around early.

    See the robots

    Not sure which one to turn up to?

    A Wednesday workday is the easiest place to start — there is no agenda to walk in on, and someone will be in the lab building something. Send us a message and we will tell you what is on this week.
